digest.component_or_area: Codex Gerrit workflow documentation and testing
propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof that Gerrit HTTPS credentials are invalid when credentials were obtained via git credential helper
AGENTS.md must document that authenticated Gerrit /a/ REST calls should use git credential fill instead of curl --netrc when Git credentials are stored in a configured helper

A shell pattern must be provided that retrieves credentials via git credential fill, passes them directly to curl, avoids echoing or logging passwords, and preserves existing git push and Gerrit gate guidance
test_codex_agent_guidance.py must contain assertions enforcing git credential fill usage, curl --netrc behavior, 401 credential validation explanation, and password non-logging requirements
